messages:
ryan: quick check before i merge PR #4826 — i'm moving per-model configmaps into per-model namespaces and adding a checksum annotation to trigger hot-reloads. any red flags w/ secrets sync or rolling updates?

ryan: snippet of the terraform resource i'm about to apply:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "model_cfg" {
  metadata {
    name = "model-${var.model}"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.model[var.model].metadata[0].name
    annotations = {
      "checksum/config" = sha256(file("${path.module}/templates/${var.model}.yaml"))
    }
  }
  data = { /* templated config */ }
}
```

anya: do we already have RBAC for the secret-sync operator to write into those model namespaces? PR touched the operator role binding.

kevin: main practical risk is rollout not triggering if the deployment doesn't pick up the annotation change. we rely on pod template annotations: make sure the deployment has `metadata.annotations.checksum/config` copied onto `spec.template.metadata.annotations`. otherwise kube won't roll pods.

ryan: good call — current deployment uses `spec.template.metadata.annotations = { checksum/config = lookup(var.annotations, \"checksum/config\", \"\") }`. will double-check.

maria: another thing — service account secret mount names changed in the per-ns move earlier today. e2e flaked because the secret-sync job wasn't creating the token in the new ns fast enough. add a preflight check for the sync-token secret.

kevin: also consider a short-lived canary label so we don't hit all models at once. create one model namespace, apply config, verify logs + readiness, then flip a rollout.

ryan: plan: (1) add RBAC tweak to operator ClusterRoleBinding (limits to model namespaces) (2) add null_resource local-exec preflight in TF to assert secret exists: `kubectl -n ${namespace} get secret sync-token` (3) ensure deployment copies annotation into pod template (4) smoke canary + rollback steps in PR description.

anya: for migration of existing configs, we'll need a one-off job to copy the old configmaps into new namespaces (namespaced name stays same but ns changes). please add notes about idempotency.

ryan: will add a kubectl job in `postdeploy` that runs a small script to copy any missing cm from `models` ns -> `model-<name>` ns. will mark it `count = 0` after successful run so TF doesn't try to keep it.

kevin: LGTM after RBAC change. one more nit: use a checksum that ignores whitespace in templates to avoid churn. `sha256(trimspace(file(...)))` or pre-normalize.

ryan: good idea, i'll normalize templates before hashing.

kevin: @infra-bot can you re-run plan for PR #4826 with the RBAC tweak?

infra-bot: terraform plan for PR #4826 — triggered by ryan at 2165556790. Summary: Plan: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. Detailed output posted to the PR.

sre-oncall: heads-up — please avoid merging during 09:00-11:00 PST tomorrow (latency window). if you must, coordinate with oncall.

maria: :thumbsup: i'll watch canary logs, let me know when you deploy.

ryan: thanks all. i'll push RBAC tweak in a sec, re-run plan, then merge and run the migration job during off-peak. will paste rollback cmds in PR: `kubectl -n <ns> rollout undo deployment/<name>` + how to revert TF.

kevin: thanks — appreciate the checklist.

ryan: merging after infra-bot comes back green. will update thread with plan link and runbook.
